title.zh: 美股周一科技股领跌,标普500跌1.91%,台股单日暴跌6.03%,金价跌至一年多低位
title.en: Wall Street sinks on tech, S&P 500 down 1.91%, Taiwan stocks plunge 6.03% and gold hits a 14-month low

points.zh: 英伟达周一收跌4.12%,美光、英特尔等芯片股重挫,标普500录得连续第三个交易日下跌;英伟达将于周二美股收盘后公布财报。
points.en: Nvidia closed down 4.12% with Micron and Intel among the hardest hit, extending the S&P 500's slide to a third day; Nvidia reports after Tuesday's US close.

points.zh: CME FedWatch显示12月加息概率约93.4%,美元偏强,金价开盘跌至2025年9月底以来最低。
points.en: CME FedWatch shows about a 93.4% chance of a December hike, the dollar is firm and gold opened at its lowest since late September 2025.

points.zh: 令吉周一早盘报4.0840/0895兑1美元,与上周五收盘几乎持平。
points.en: The ringgit opened Monday at 4.0840/0895 per US dollar, almost flat from Friday's close.

takeaway.zh: 市场情绪紧绷的日子,信托基金顾问通常会提醒:先回到自己的目标、投资期限和风险承受度,稳定的投资节奏往往比盯着每日行情更重要。
takeaway.en: On tense days a unit trust consultant would generally remind you to return to your goals, time horizon and risk tolerance; a steady routine often matters more than watching every daily move.

title.zh: 美股周一科技股领跌:标普500跌1.91%,英伟达跌4.12%
title.en: Wall Street falls as tech leads: S&P 500 down 1.91%, Nvidia down 4.12%

analysis.zh: 据Investing.com,周一道指跌737.24点(1.41%)至51,610.31,标普500跌1.91%至7,417.12,纳指跌2.49%。英伟达收跌4.12%至156.14美元,美光跌7.62%,英特尔跌7.07%;恐慌指数VIX升至约22.9。就像一堂课里最亮眼的几位同学同时失手,整班的平均分自然被拉低。
analysis.en: According to Investing.com, on Monday the Dow fell 737.24 points (1.41%) to 51,610.31, the S&P 500 fell 1.91% to 7,417.12 and the Nasdaq fell 2.49%. Nvidia closed down 4.12% at $156.14, Micron fell 7.62% and Intel 7.07%, and the VIX rose to about 22.9. It is like several of the star pupils slipping at once, which drags down the whole class average.

dda.zh: 市场大跌时最容易想停止或改变计划。定期定额(DDA)按固定节奏投入,通常有助于减少因单日行情而冲动调整的情况。
dda.en: Sharp falls make it tempting to pause or change plans. Regular (DDA) investing at a fixed rhythm may help reduce impulsive changes driven by one day's move.

prs.zh: 退休规划的时间跨度往往以数十年计,单日跌幅通常不是重点。可以顺便看看PRS基金的科技股占比,也别忘了每年最高RM3,000的PRS税务减免。
prs.en: Retirement horizons often span decades, so a single day's drop is usually not the main story. It may be a good moment to see how much tech your PRS fund holds, and to remember the PRS tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year.

lump.zh: 一天内芯片股集体大跌,提醒我们留意集中在单一主题的风险。分批投入可以分散入市时机的风险,金额则应符合个人目标与风险承受度。
lump.en: Chip stocks falling together in one day is a reminder to check concentration in a single theme. Phasing in may spread timing risk, and the amount should fit your goals and risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 这主要是美国股市和科技股的消息,对马来西亚债券基金(MGS、企业债与伊斯兰债券)的直接影响有限。股市波动加大时,债券基金一般扮演组合平衡者的角色。
bond.en: This is mainly a US equity and tech story, so the direct effect on Malaysian bond funds (MGS, corporate bonds and sukuk) is limited. When equity swings widen, bond funds generally act as a portfolio balancer.

title.zh: 加息预期升温、美元偏强,金价开盘跌至2025年9月底以来最低
title.en: Rate-hike bets and a firm dollar push gold to its lowest open since late September 2025

analysis.zh: 据Yahoo Finance,12月黄金期货周一开盘报3,869.70美元,较上周五开盘低0.4%,过去一周累计下跌7.7%。CME FedWatch显示联储局12月8至9日会议后加息的概率约为93.4%,美元走强、10年期美债收益率偏高,令不生息的黄金承压。利率越高,持有黄金的“机会成本”就越高,好比存款利息变高后,把钱放在不生息的东西上就显得吃亏。
analysis.en: According to Yahoo Finance, December gold futures opened Monday at $3,869.70 an ounce, 0.4% below Friday's open and down 7.7% over the past week. CME FedWatch shows about a 93.4% chance of a hike after the Fed's 8-9 December meeting, and a stronger dollar and high 10-year yields weigh on non-yielding gold. Higher rates raise the opportunity cost of holding gold, like how a higher deposit rate makes cash sitting in a non-interest asset look costlier.

dda.zh: 黄金和股市一样会大幅波动。定期定额(DDA)的好处之一,是不必猜测哪一天是低点,按计划持续投入即可。
dda.en: Gold swings as much as shares can. One benefit of regular (DDA) investing is that you do not have to guess which day is the low; you keep investing on schedule.

prs.zh: 美国利率走高的环境下,PRS基金里的债券与股票部分都可能受影响。检查基金的资产配置是否仍符合退休年龄与风险承受度,会比追逐金价更实际。
prs.en: With US rates elevated, both the bond and equity parts of a PRS fund may be affected. Checking whether the fund still suits your retirement age and risk tolerance is more practical than chasing the gold price.

lump.zh: 一周内跌7.7%的资产,提醒我们不要把单笔资金押在单一资产上。分批投入可以分散时机风险,并留意整体组合的集中度。
lump.en: An asset that drops 7.7% in a week is a reminder not to commit a lump sum to a single asset. Phasing in may spread timing risk, and it helps to watch overall portfolio concentration.

bond.zh: 美国加息预期通常会推高全球收益率并支撑美元,可能影响令吉和外资对马来西亚债券的流向。不过国家银行的OPR走向取决于本地通胀与增长,债券基金的表现也要看久期与信用质量。
bond.en: Expectations of US hikes generally lift global yields and support the dollar, which may affect the ringgit and foreign flows into Malaysian bonds. Still, Bank Negara's OPR path depends on local inflation and growth, and bond fund results also depend on duration and credit quality.

title.en: Taiwan shares plunge 6.03% on Monday to close at 41,040.08

analysis.zh: 据Focus Taiwan,台湾加权指数周一重挫2,635.04点,跌幅6.03%,收于41,040.08点,成交额达8,450.6亿新台币。该社另一篇报道把这次下跌与对黄仁勋辞任英伟达CEO的担忧及期指卖压联系起来。台股以AI供应链权重高见称,所以英伟达的消息很容易引发大幅震荡。
analysis.en: According to Focus Taiwan, the Taiex fell 2,635.04 points, or 6.03%, to close at 41,040.08 on turnover of NT$845.06 billion. A related Focus Taiwan report ties the drop to concerns over Jensen Huang's resignation as Nvidia CEO and futures selling. Taiwan's market is heavily weighted to the AI supply chain, so Nvidia news can trigger large swings.

dda.zh: 一天暴跌6%的市场,提醒我们单一国家或单一主题的风险。定期定额(DDA)配合分散投资,通常有助于降低对单一消息的依赖。
dda.en: A market that drops 6% in a day highlights single-country and single-theme risk. Regular (DDA) investing combined with diversification may help reduce dependence on any one headline.

prs.zh: 退休规划要看十年、二十年后的目标。检查PRS基金是否过度集中在科技或某个市场,比预测短期涨跌更有意义。
prs.en: Retirement planning looks ten or twenty years ahead. Checking whether a PRS fund is too concentrated in tech or one market is more meaningful than predicting short-term moves.

lump.zh: 波动剧烈时,不宜一次性投入大笔资金追入或抛出。分批投入可以分散时机风险,同时确认金额与自己的风险承受度相符。
lump.en: When swings are violent, putting in a large sum all at once, or selling in a hurry, is generally unwise. Phasing in may spread timing risk, and the amount should match your risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 台股的震荡对马来西亚债券基金的直接影响有限,但全球风险情绪转弱时,资金有时会流向相对稳健的资产。债券基金一般可以在组合里起到平衡作用。
bond.en: The Taiwan sell-off has limited direct effect on Malaysian bond funds, but when global risk sentiment weakens, money sometimes moves toward steadier assets. Bond funds can generally help balance a portfolio.

title.zh: 台湾央行总裁:黄仁勋离任对台湾AI供应商只是“短期震荡”
title.en: Taiwan central bank chief: Huang's exit means only 'short-term turbulence' for Taiwan's AI suppliers

analysis.zh: 据Focus Taiwan,央行总裁杨金龙在立法院财政委员会表示,黄仁勋辞任英伟达CEO预计会带来短期震荡,但对台湾在全球AI供应链的角色有信心;在英伟达任命新CEO前不确定性会持续,央行也在留意市场流动性与资金流向。他说英伟达在台北的海外总部合约一旦签署很少更改,预计不受影响。就像一家大客户换了掌门人,供应商短期会不安,但生意关系不一定马上改变。
analysis.en: According to Focus Taiwan, central bank Governor Yang Chin-long told the Legislature's Finance Committee that Jensen Huang's resignation as Nvidia CEO should bring short-term turbulence, but he is confident in Taiwan's role in the global AI supply chain; uncertainty will persist until Nvidia names a new CEO, and the central bank is monitoring liquidity and fund flows. He said Nvidia's planned Taipei overseas headquarters deal rarely changes once signed and is unlikely to be affected. It is like a big customer changing its boss: suppliers feel uneasy for a while, but the business relationship does not necessarily change at once.

dda.zh: 官方强调“短期”与“长期”的区别,正好呼应DDA的理念:长期目标不应被短期事件牵着走,按计划持续投入即可。
dda.en: The official's distinction between short and long term echoes the idea behind DDA: long-term goals need not be steered by short-term events, so you keep investing on plan.

prs.zh: PRS是为退休而长期持有的账户,期间难免遇上类似的人事变动与市场震荡。定期检视而不是频繁调整,通常更适合退休规划。
prs.en: A PRS account is held long term for retirement, and it will meet leadership changes and swings like this along the way. Periodic reviews rather than frequent changes usually suit retirement planning better.

lump.zh: 当一个主题的不确定性仍未解决(例如新CEO人选),单笔投资者不妨先确认自己在该主题上的集中度,再考虑分批投入。
lump.en: While uncertainty on a theme is unresolved, such as who the new CEO will be, a lump-sum investor may first check their concentration in that theme, then consider phasing in.

bond.zh: 这是一则关于台湾科技供应链的新闻,对马来西亚债券基金的直接影响有限。债券基金在组合中一般起到稳定与平衡的作用。
bond.en: This story is about Taiwan's tech supply chain, so the direct effect on Malaysian bond funds is limited. Bond funds generally play a stabilising, balancing role in a portfolio.

title.zh: 中东出口恢复、国际能源署预期第四季供应过剩,油价周一大跌约3.6%
title.en: Oil falls about 3.6% as Middle East exports recover and the IEA sees a Q4 surplus

analysis.zh: 据CNBC,周一WTI原油结算下跌3.58%至每桶85.39美元,布伦特约跌3.55%至92.44美元。国际能源署上周五表示,预计第四季全球供应将超出需求170万桶/日,扭转此前短缺的预测,原因是中东出口恢复速度快于需求;高盛预计布伦特2027年均价为88美元。油价下跌通常有助于减轻通胀压力,就像加油站的价格牌调低,家庭和企业的开销也会缓和一点。
analysis.en: According to CNBC, on Monday WTI settled down 3.58% at $85.39 a barrel and Brent fell 3.55% to $92.44. The IEA said on Friday it now expects global supply to exceed demand by more than 1.7 million barrels a day in the fourth quarter, reversing an earlier deficit forecast as Middle East exports recover faster than demand; Goldman Sachs expects Brent to average $88 in 2027. Lower oil generally eases inflation pressure, much like a lower price on the petrol station board eases household and business costs.

dda.zh: 油价和通胀会影响各类资产的表现,但很难预测。定期定额(DDA)不需要判断油价高低,持续投入即可平均成本。
dda.en: Oil and inflation influence many asset classes but are hard to predict. Regular (DDA) investing does not require calling oil prices; steady contributions help average the cost.

prs.zh: 通胀是退休规划的长期敌人之一。能源价格回落若持续,可能缓解生活成本压力,但规划退休金时仍应以长期通胀假设为准。
prs.en: Inflation is a long-term opponent of retirement planning. If lower energy prices persist they may ease living costs, but retirement projections should still use long-run inflation assumptions.

lump.zh: 能源类股票与基金对油价敏感,单笔投资前不妨确认组合里能源相关资产的占比,并分批投入以分散时机风险。
lump.en: Energy shares and funds are sensitive to oil, so before investing a lump sum it may help to check the portfolio's energy exposure and to phase in to spread timing risk.

bond.zh: 油价下跌可能减轻通胀压力,从而降低利率进一步上调的压力,对债券一般偏有利。马来西亚是石油与天然气出口国,油价变动也可能影响国家收入与令吉,但最终仍取决于多项因素。
bond.en: Lower oil may ease inflation pressure and with it the pressure for higher rates, which generally leans favourable for bonds. Malaysia exports oil and gas, so oil moves may also affect national revenue and the ringgit, though many other factors matter too.

title.zh: 令吉周一早盘几乎持平,报4.0840/0895,市场预期联储局加息
title.en: Ringgit opens almost flat at 4.0840/0895 as markets price a Fed hike

analysis.zh: 据The Star,令吉周一早上8点报4.0840/0895兑1美元,上周五收盘为4.0845/0890。Bank Muamalat首席经济师Mohd Afzanizam表示,美国通胀预期上升强化了联储局的鹰派立场,市场正为12月加息布局,美元指数约在103点,10年期美债收益率维持在5%以上,这“将在短期内继续支撑美元”。令吉兑欧元、英镑、新加坡元和泰铢则略有走强。美元走强对令吉像是一场拔河:对手力气大,但令吉暂时没被拉动。
analysis.en: According to The Star, the ringgit opened at 4.0840/0895 per US dollar at 8 am on Monday versus 4.0845/0890 at Friday's close. Bank Muamalat chief economist Dr Mohd Afzanizam Abdul Rashid said higher US inflation expectations have reinforced the Fed's hawkish stance, with markets positioning for a December hike; the US Dollar Index is around 103 and the 10-year Treasury yield is above 5%, which 'should continue to underpin the US dollar in the near term'. The ringgit was mostly firmer against the euro, pound, Singapore dollar and baht. A strong dollar is like a tug of war: the other side is pulling hard, but the ringgit has not budged for now.

dda.zh: 汇率波动会影响海外基金以令吉计价的回报。DDA长期持续投入,可以让买入汇率也随时间分散。
dda.en: Exchange rates affect the ringgit value of overseas funds. Investing regularly via DDA over a long period spreads the entry exchange rate over time too.

prs.zh: PRS基金若含海外资产,令吉汇率会影响其回报。检视一下基金的海外比重,并留意每年最高RM3,000的PRS税务减免,是务实的做法。
prs.en: If a PRS fund holds overseas assets, the ringgit exchange rate affects its returns. Reviewing the fund's overseas share, and remembering the PRS tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year, is a practical step.

lump.zh: 投资海外资产的单笔资金,会受到入市当天汇率影响。分批投入可以分散汇率与市场时机的风险,金额应符合个人目标。
lump.en: A lump sum invested overseas is exposed to the exchange rate on the day it goes in. Phasing in may spread currency and market timing risk, and the amount should fit your goals.

bond.zh: 美国利率预期与美元走势,可能影响外资对马来西亚债券(MGS、企业债与伊斯兰债券)的兴趣和令吉汇率。国家银行的OPR走向取决于本地通胀与增长;债券基金的表现也取决于久期与信用质量。
bond.en: US rate expectations and the dollar may affect foreign interest in Malaysian bonds (MGS, corporate bonds and sukuk) and the ringgit. Bank Negara's OPR path depends on local inflation and growth, and bond fund results also depend on duration and credit quality.

title.zh: 本周焦点:英伟达周二盘后公布财报,联储局主席沃什发言受关注
title.en: This week's focus: Nvidia reports after Tuesday's close, Fed Chair Warsh's remarks watched

analysis.zh: 据Investing.com,英伟达上周跌逾12%,市值跌破4万亿美元,CEO黄仁勋离任后,第三财季业绩将于周二美股收盘后公布。联储局主席沃什讨论了AI对经济影响的员工模型,包括AI取代工人的情境,市场也在权衡更激进加息的可能性;家得宝、塔吉特与沃尔玛本周也将公布财报,可作为消费支出的参考。一周里有这么多大事,就像考试周挤在一起,难免让市场情绪起伏。
analysis.en: According to Investing.com, Nvidia fell more than 12% last week, pushing its market value below $4 trillion, and with CEO Jensen Huang out, its fiscal third-quarter results are due after Tuesday's US close. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh discussed staff models of AI's economic impact, including scenarios where AI displaces workers, and markets also weighed the prospect of more aggressive rate increases; Home Depot, Target and Walmart report later this week, which may offer a read on consumer spending. With so many big events in one week it is like exam week piling up, so sentiment naturally swings.

dda.zh: 财报、发言和数据密集的一周,正是定期定额(DDA)的价值所在:不必猜测事件结果,按计划持续投入即可。
dda.en: In a week crowded with earnings, speeches and data, regular (DDA) investing shows its value: you do not have to guess the outcomes and simply keep investing on plan.

prs.zh: 关于AI取代工作的讨论,也提醒退休规划不要只依赖单一收入来源。可以趁机检视PRS供款是否持续,以及每年最高RM3,000的税务减免是否用足。
prs.en: Talk of AI displacing work is also a reminder not to rely on a single income source in retirement planning. It may be a good time to check that PRS contributions are on track and the annual tax relief of up to RM3,000 is used.

lump.zh: 重大财报前后股价往往波动较大。单笔投资者可以先确认自己对AI与科技主题的集中度,再考虑分批投入以分散时机风险。
lump.en: Share prices often swing around major earnings. A lump-sum investor may first check exposure to AI and tech themes, then consider phasing in to spread timing risk.

bond.zh: 联储局若继续加息,全球收益率可能维持高位,对债券价格带来压力;不过高收益率也意味着新增投资的票息较高。马来西亚债券基金的影响还要看国家银行立场、令吉与外资流向。
bond.en: If the Fed keeps raising rates, global yields may stay elevated, which can pressure bond prices, although higher yields also mean higher coupons on new money. For Malaysian bond funds, Bank Negara's stance, the ringgit and foreign flows matter too.
